# Issue 62 independent proactive visual QA

Issue: [Account access, guarded sign-out, and deletion](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/62). Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**, dedicated to issue 62 only. Date: **2026-10-25**, Windows, headless installed Playwright Chromium. This is an independent review, not acceptance or a request to reopen the issue.

## Snapshot and method

Baseline HEAD: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence were preserved. `git status --short -- frontend` was empty after capture. No product, specification, Git index, GitHub, real account or external service was changed. Reviewer-created files are confined to this directory. The packet's saved live issue snapshot `contracts/issue-62.md` is the task contract; Flow 15, current tokens, adoption mapping and reference catalog supply shared requirements. Old acceptance reports were navigation leads only, not fresh proof.

Three bounded disposable scripts ran against a reviewer-owned mock Vite on `127.0.0.1:4362`:

- `capture.cjs`: visible native mock registration using a synthetic `example.invalid` identity and the code visibly supplied by the mock UI; Account, password rejection, localized tokens, cancel/Escape, linking entry, deletion recovery-storage refusal and authoritative mock deletion.
- `fixtures.cjs`: existing `e2e/harness/workspace-state-visual.html` controlled facade. `account-locale-pending` deliberately holds `account.setLocale`; locale failure returns `adapter-unavailable`; deletion error returns that error; deletion unknown and status resolution return `unknown`. These prove presentation under a controlled result, not durable service behavior. Neither-linked native state and both-linked fixture state are distinguished.
- `guard.cjs`: second visible mock registration, packaged `source-dialogue.mp4`, upload/quote/process UI, fake microphone capture, and common-header Sign out with an unaccepted candidate. Stay and discard/leave were exercised. Browser audio was muted; no physical microphone or speakers were used. Read-only `createServices().identity.current()` checked signed-in truth after wrong password/Stay and absence after sign-out.

One explicit fault injection overrides `sessionStorage.setItem` to throw only in the disposable native context. The UI blocks deletion before submitting and names recovery-storage failure; the original method is restored before normal deletion. No real deletion/retention/revocation claim follows from local mocks.

Initial capture runs exposed a review-script strict selector collision and an overly early recording-gate check; only disposable scripts were corrected and rerun. A deletion-success selector initially expected literal `Account deleted`; the actual localized landing copy is `This account was deleted.` The final successful capture records that actual result. These tooling errors are not product findings.

Commands: `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --mode mock --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4362 --strictPort` from `frontend`; then `node .../issue-62/capture.cjs`, `fixtures.cjs`, and `guard.cjs` from the repository. Exact commands/scripts and final output are retained here. The initial escalation failure due to account usage was resolved after the root independently demonstrated a successful environment read; it is not an outstanding blocker.

## Result

**0 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 LOW findings.** Four are confirmed implementation defects; two are product/design critique or polish. No immediate destructive safety failure was observed in this bounded mock pass. This does not establish the complete issue acceptance matrix.

## Expected versus actual

| Contract | Expected | Fresh actual and evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-01, F15-AC01/02 | Current owner; Language/methods/Sign out/deletion hierarchy; truthful locale pending, rollback and Retry | Native owner and hierarchy correct. EN/RU update together. Controlled failure restores English and exposes Retry. Held save has no saving status; failure copy incorrectly says the language changed here after rollback. `18-fixture-account-locale-*` | Partial; QA-62-03 |
| AC-02 | Two method families, add-only continuation, Current/New fields, field-specific rejection and retained active values | Native Google unlinked and email verified; no removal actions. Link opens separate proof flow. Incorrect current password preserves both values but falsely claims session ended. Two desktop inputs are vertically misaligned. `03`, `15`, `14-account-ru-768` | Mismatch; QA-62-01/06 |
| AC-03 | Shared coordinator resolves candidate before ending session; Stay sends no logout | Header Sign out presents all three guard choices; Stay keeps route, candidate and authenticated identity. Leave without saving reaches landing and `identity.current()` confirms null. `19`, `20`, `guard-metrics.json` | Bounded pass; Save/failure/unknown/other-device cases not rerun |
| AC-04 | Account-naming desktop dialog/phone sheet; exact localized tokens; cancel/focus; known consequences | Sheet/dialog and token gating work in EN/RU. Wrong locale/internal/extra chars rejected; trimmed lowercase accepted. Escape restores initiating focus. Consequences and purchased remainder shown. Account identity is absent inside dialog. `04`, `08`, `10` | Mismatch; QA-62-02 |
| AC-05 | No success on error/unknown; confirmed deletion clears private UI and opens signed-out landing | Controlled error/unknown keep dialog and do not navigate; unknown disables resubmission and offers Check deletion status. Native deletion reaches `/` and signed-out landing with `This account was deleted.` `17`, `18-fixture-account-delete-*` | Bounded pass; idempotency/reload/late responses not rerun |
| AC-06 | New canonical account/no repeat grant on later registration; no external-file erasure promise | External-file/backup limitation visibly disclosed. Later registration and eligibility accounting not repeated. | Evidence gap |
| AC-07, AC-VIS-01 | Mabry, source states, responsive targets and specified readable body/dialogue | Mabry resource faces load and controls report Mabry after `fonts.ready`; EN/RU fit at 390/767/768/1440, no document horizontal overflow. Phone action buttons 48 px. Dialog consequences are 14/21 rather than required 16/24. `metrics.json`, `fixture-metrics.json` | Partial; QA-62-04/05/06 |
| AC-08 | Simulated scope clearly labeled; no production assertion | Native and controlled views explicitly show simulated account notices. All state mutation remains local mock. | Bounded pass; production gates unverified |

## Reference comparison and measurements

Read and visually opened portable BTN `source/components/button/Clean/button-clean.md.txt` plus `Light/01-initial.png`, and PRO `source/components/profile-menu/Clean/profile-menu-clean.md.txt` plus `Light/01-initial.png`, under `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/`. SHA-256 values verified against the manifest: BTN Markdown `87e82cd5...bd5e6`, BTN PNG `11fdc403...881c6`, PRO Markdown `0bc1d998...b2`, PRO PNG `702033f1...dfce`. The source PNGs' preview scale and example content are not page-layout requirements.

| Source/state | Product map and observed treatment | Adaptation/limit |
|---|---|---|
| BTN default/secondary/ghost/destructive, Clean 289–440 | Dark Save; white subtle Link/Sign out; quiet reset/Cancel; red on soft red Delete; 28 px / 13 px desktop; source radius 6 | Mabry substitution and stronger semantic danger/focus are approved. Styling is recognizable. Compact geometry is critiqued separately below. |
| BTN / PRO -> derived deletion surface | PRO-like floating white surface, focusable input, localized actions, phone bottom sheet | No direct Affect Dialog exists. Product dialog copy must retain 16/24 body role; measured 14/21 does not inherit a source exception. |
| PRO quiet row -> method facts | Both supported method rows, text states and icons; native add-only link continuation | Native Google row is unlinked; both-linked fixture is explicitly synthetic. No fresh dual-proof commit was performed for this issue. |
| Derived locale/input | Native select, two password fields, visible focus outline | Desktop select 48 px, password fields 40 px, commands 28 px. Phone commands and fields 48 px. Uneven desktop field alignment is visible. |

At 1440x900, content is 1200 px wide, left 120; the main page's first heading is near y170. In the native full-page measurement, Save password begins at y917, Sign out y1050 and Delete account y1189. The desktop screenshot therefore cannot show all primary settings actions in the initial viewport. At 1440x700, only Language and the first part of method facts appear without scrolling. At 390x844 both locales stack cleanly; long page scrolling is available. This is not a horizontal-overflow or hidden-action failure.

## Findings

### QA-62-01 — MEDIUM — Wrong current password falsely reports that the session ended

**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-02; Flow 15 §6.2 and field-error contract.

**Reproduce:** register a fresh mock email/password account; open Account; enter a wrong Current password and a valid-length New password; select Save password.

**Expected:** a recoverable Current password error under that field, keeping the current session and both active values. **Actual:** the global red notice says **“Your session ended. Sign in to continue.”** Both values remain. A read-only current-session check returns `status: ok`, `stillAuthenticated: true`; Account and later actions remain usable. This is not a screenshot-only inference.

**Cause evidence:** `frontend/src/services/mock-identity.ts:1486` emits `unauthenticated` for incorrect current password. `AccountScreen.tsx:438` stores only the generic error code and `:700` renders ServiceNotice. `frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts:66` maps that code to session-ended copy. Field specificity is lost before rendering.

**Impact:** users may abandon the form or sign out unnecessarily, and cannot tell whether the current password or session is the problem. **Recommendation:** give wrong-current-password a field-specific representation distinct from expired/missing session; render it beneath Current password while retaining both values. **Next validation:** wrong password in EN/RU retains values/session and highlights only Current; genuine expiry still offers the sign-in path.

![Wrong current password rendered as session expiry](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-62/evidence/03-password-error-en-desktop.png)

### QA-62-02 — MEDIUM — Deletion confirmation does not identify the account being deleted

**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-04; Flow 15 §8.2 step 2 explicitly requires the dialog/sheet to name the account.

**Reproduce:** open Delete account on native Account at desktop or phone. **Expected:** authorized account identity inside the accessible confirmation surface alongside consequences and token. **Actual:** generic “Delete this account?” / “Удалить этот аккаунт?” with no identifier inside the modal. The Account heading's email is outside it, often above the scrolled viewport and inaccessible as modal context. This also applies to controlled fixture dialogs.

**Cause evidence:** `AccountScreen.tsx:765–769` renders generic title/body and purchased remainder, with no account-specific identity. The page identity at `:610` is outside the dialog. **Impact:** users controlling multiple accounts receive weaker final assurance before irreversible deletion. **Recommendation:** insert the service-authoritative account identifier in the dialog's accessible content; avoid inventing a primary address. **Next validation:** two distinct account fixtures produce distinct EN/RU dialog content and accessible descriptions, with no prior-account flash.

![Phone deletion surface lacks account identity](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-62/evidence/10-delete-ru-phone.png)

### QA-62-03 — MEDIUM — Locale saving has no pending state, and rollback copy contradicts the restored UI

**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-01 and AC-VIS-01; Flow 15 §5, line 82.

**Reproduce:** use the existing account-locale-pending harness; change Account Language EN -> RU. The facade call remains held. Then repeat in account-locale-failure, which returns adapter-unavailable.

**Expected:** visible truthful Saving state while persistence is pending; on failure restore authoritative language and provide accurate Retry copy. **Actual:** held request switches the whole page to RU with no indication that saving remains unresolved. Failure correctly restores EN and provides Retry, but says **“The language changed here, but the account preference could not be saved.”** The visible control and page are English again, not the chosen Russian.

**Cause evidence:** `frontend/src/app/locale.tsx:17` exposes no pending/saving state; internal `pendingLocale` at `:62` is absent from the public value at `:150–158`. `AccountScreen.tsx:635–652` renders selection and error only. `frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts:45–46` uses copy inconsistent with the rollback implemented at `locale.tsx:99–103`.

**Impact:** users may navigate away believing a preference is saved, or misunderstand a failed change. **Recommendation:** expose and announce pending persistence next to the control; change failure copy to say the previous language was restored and the requested preference can be retried. **Next validation:** delayed success/failure in both locales, including Retry, with matching visible locale and status throughout. This finding concerns rendering under a controlled facade; it does not assert a production service delay.

![Held locale-save request without pending feedback](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-62/evidence/18-fixture-account-locale-pending.png)

![Locale failure restores English but copy says it changed here](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-62/evidence/18-fixture-account-locale-failure.png)

### QA-62-04 — MEDIUM — Irreversible-deletion disclosure is smaller than the retained dialog-body contract

**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-07, AC-VIS-01; Flow 15 line 68; design-tokens lines 83–99.
